ai.title: Fix disconnected stream retention
ai.summary: Added `skipDisconnectedBilling` for DeepSeek V4 Flash to cancel streams on client disconnect, preventing unnecessary consumption. Implemented `DISCONNECTED_STREAM_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS` (2m) in OpenRouter to cancel disconnected streams that exceed the drain window. Updated chat completions telemetry to omit message bodies for `limited` access tiers. Changes affect `web/src/llm-api/deepseek.ts`, `web/src/llm-api/openrouter.ts`, and `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts`.

eli5.text: When you're using the newer DeepSeek model or OpenRouter for chat, the service now detects when your connection drops mid-response and cleanly cancels the still-running generation instead of letting it keep going and potentially getting billed for work you didn't receive. For OpenRouter, it waits about two minutes after a disconnect to give a final chance at recovery before fully cancelling, and for DeepSeek's newest Flash model it cancels immediately since that version supports it. Behind the scenes, it also keeps your message content out of error logging when you're on the restricted limited access tier, recording that it was omitted instead of the actual text. This is live today for those specific models and the telemetry changes apply to how request errors are recorded going forward.

ai.title: Add compact live stats to homepage
ai.summary: Added `CompactLiveStats` component to `home-client.tsx`. Updated `/api/live` cache headers to `s-maxage=60` and `stale-while-revalidate=30`. Server `getFreebuffLiveStats` now caches results for 60s. Client polling interval increased from 15s to 60s.

eli5.text: The homepage now shows a small live snapshot of Freebuff activity, so you can see real-time usage at a glance instead of visiting a separate page. That count now refreshes every 60 seconds (up from 15) and is served from a short-term cache, which keeps the numbers steady while reducing how often the site checks for updates.

ai.title: Windows CLI builds switch to bun-windows-x64-baseline target
ai.summary: Windows binary compilation now targets bun-windows-x64-baseline instead of bun-windows-x64. A new composite action downloads and caches the specific Bun runtime zip, setting BUN_COMPILE_EXECUTABLE_PATH for the build script. cli/scripts/build-binary.ts passes this path to bun build --compile-executable-path when present. Scope covers CI workflows (cli-release-build, freebuff-e2e, npm-app-release-build) and the CLI build script.

ai.title: Reduce chat request retention
ai.summary: Chat request logging now uses createRequestAuditRecord to store request summaries instead of full bodies. This change addresses retention issues by omitting messages from BigQuery inserts and telemetry. Covers all LLM API handlers (CanopyWave, DeepSeek, Fireworks, Moonshot, OpenAI, OpenCodeZen) and the main chat completions endpoint. The new helper extracts model, stream, temperature, max_tokens, and message/tool counts while setting messages_omitted: true.

eli5.text: Your chat requests are now being logged with a condensed version that skips the actual conversation content (messages get omitted). Instead of saving the full chat request details until a provider finishes processing, the system now saves a summary with just the essentials like model, temperature, and message counts to the main logs, while the complete request still goes to a separate storage table upfront. This means your conversations aren't retained in the telemetry logs that were previously held until streaming completed, reducing how long full chat data lingers in the system during processing.

ai.title: CLI model selector adapts to short terminals
ai.summary: CLI waiting-room components implement progressive disclosure for low-height terminals. The `useLogo` hook downgrades the ASCII art to a single-line text variant when the vertical budget falls below 6 rows. The `FreebuffModelSelector` and `LimitedLandingPanel` now accept a `maxHeight` prop, enabling internal scrollboxes with precise layout math to prevent flexbox compression. This ensures the model picker remains accessible and visually stable on small screens.

eli5.text: When you open the model selection screen in the CLI on a terminal that isn't very tall, the logo now shrinks or disappears to make room, and the list of models scrolls in a box instead of squishing everything together. The picker keeps keyboard focus visible as you move through the models, and the logo automatically downgrades to a single text line when there are fewer than six rows available. This is live today for anyone running the CLI on short terminals.
